projections.note: What a leaderboard row is. Every field here is public, which is the point: an entry that carried one narrower field would be a shape the server has to redact per viewer, and a redaction that fails open publishes it.
The four fields that never leave the participant's own surface. This shape exists so that the narrowing is a schema boundary rather than a per-field redaction on a public shape.

fields.name: token_burn_total
fields.reason: D-144. Published beside credited_token_burn it yields the composite weight by division, and since evidence_class is already public that yields the trust factor and therefore the sanction D-084 keeps private.

fields.name: confidence_weight_hundredths
fields.reason: The composite ADR-020 weight. Publishing it is publishing the sanction directly rather than by division.

fields.name: evidence_factor_hundredths
fields.reason: One of the two factors. Public alone it would let the trust factor be recovered from the composite.

fields.name: trust_factor_hundredths
fields.reason: The ranked-identity trust state expressed as a number. It is the sanction.

fields.name: recent_credited_token_burn
fields.reason: A short-window series. Differencing it against the published credited figure recovers the weight over that window.

fields.name: trust_notice_id
fields.reason: D-227 records the limit it works around: the ranked-identity states ADR-020 reads are marked internal, so a participant reaches their own trust state as a notice reference rather than by name.

projections.note: Served only after the current-viewer-authorization profile admits the viewer. Public here means public-once-authorized, and the authorization is the D-326 rule rather than a property of this shape.
The participant's own account. `admitted` is a boolean rather than a lifecycle under D-288, because the account is told none of the five invite states.

fields.name: visibility
fields.reason: A viewer who could read the setting could tell a private profile from one they are merely not authorized for, which is the distinction privacy exists to remove.

fields.name: admitted
fields.reason: D-288. It renders the redemption screen without provoking a 403, and it says nothing to anyone else about the size or membership of the invite ring.

fields.name: revision
fields.reason: A concurrency token for the participant's own conditional updates; it has no meaning to a third party.

projections.note: An accepted claim as its own submitter sees it. No claim is ever public: the binding rules admit only fixed-schema aggregate accounting across the device boundary, and a per-claim record on a public surface would be an activity timeline.

fields.name: claim_id
fields.reason: Names one submission by one device at one time.

fields.name: device_id
fields.reason: Which of the participant's machines was working.

fields.name: sequence
fields.reason: The lineage position; a sequence disclosed publicly is a count of the participant's sessions.

fields.name: state
fields.reason: A retracted or quarantined claim is an integrity outcome, which D-084 keeps private to the participant.

fields.name: evidence_class
fields.reason: Public in aggregate on the profile; per claim it would let an observer locate the exact submission that changed a participant's class.

fields.name: payload_digest
fields.reason: Bound to one claim, so it is an identifier for a submission even though the digest itself discloses nothing.

fields.name: appraisal_id
fields.reason: Names the verifier appraisal, which is integrity-private.

fields.name: accepted_at
fields.reason: An exact acceptance time is a working-hours signal at a resolution the presence projection deliberately does not offer.

projections.note: The projection, never the lease. `availability` is the three-value collapse the binding table declares; the underlying five-state lease, the device and the generation stay server-side.
A closed-world typed event. There is no free-text field and no payload, which is what makes it impossible for a notification to carry source-derived content.

fields.name: notification_id
fields.reason: Addresses one row in one participant's inbox.

fields.name: type
fields.reason: The event class; it is the participant's own inbox and nobody else's.

fields.name: actor_account_id
fields.reason: Who caused it. Disclosed to the recipient only, and rechecked at delivery time under D-326 in case the actor was blocked after the row was created.

fields.name: scope_id
fields.reason: The board, generation or case the event is about.

fields.name: state
fields.reason: Includes retracted, which is a correction to this recipient and to nobody else.

fields.name: created_at
fields.reason: The recipient's own inbox timeline.
